claims.text: Postmenopausal w atrophic vaginitis or urethritis: topical estrogen markedly ↓recurr UTI.
claims.quote: topical estrogen therapy markedly reduces the incidence of recurrent UTI in patients with atrophic vaginitis or atrophic urethritis

claims.text: Cranberry products (w other behavioral measures) may be considered.
claims.quote: The use of cranberry products, in addition to other behavioral measures, may be considered another strategy to prevent recurrent cystitis

claims.text: Methenamine: efficacious in older adults w CrCl > 30 mL/min.
claims.quote: Methenamine has been shown to be efficacious in the prevention of UTI in older adults with creatinine clearance > 30 mL/min

claims.text: If behavioral measures fail: abx ppx, continuous or postcoital:
claims.quote: If these techniques are unsuccessful, antibiotic prophylaxis should be considered. Common options are continuous and postcoital prophylaxis

claims.text: TMP-SMX 40/200 mg daily or 3x/wk, nitrofurantoin 50 or 100 mg daily, cephalexin 125 to 250 mg daily, or fosfomycin 3 g q10 days.
claims.quote: Common options are trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 40/200 mg orally once a day or 3 times a week, nitrofurantoin 50 or 100 mg orally once a day, cephalexin 125 to 250 mg orally once a day, and fosfomycin 3 g orally every 10 days

claims.text: Beers (older adults): avoid nitrofurantoin if CrCl <30 mL/min or for long-term suppression.
claims.quote: Avoid in individuals with CrCl <30 mL/ min or for long-term suppression
